channel.title: Tripwire — alerts
channel.description: Three signal packages — ASX, global, momentum — where the weights add to 100% by construction, so "combined" is arithmetic and not a promise. Each package ships with its live combined move, a live graph drawn from our own hourly reads, the research note behind the weights, and an hourly alert when the basket itself moves past its ±% — on a hash-chained log you can verify. Underneath: 31 markets across six classes from public keyless APIs. Free quotes, free feed, free board; paid hourly email.
